elevation.$description: Elevation is the *role* a surface plays; shadow is the raw value it renders with. Components pick a role (surface.raised, overlay, modal) and never a shadow number, so the ladder can be retuned in one place. Theme-aware: light renders with soft warm-graphite shadows; dark (theme/dark/elevation.json) with deeper shadows, a warm rim, and the surface-luminance ladder.

ramp.$description: The Tailwind shadow scale (shadow-2xs…shadow-xl), exposed as semantic aliases so src/styles/index.css can map the utilities without restating the values or reaching into the primitive layer.
